name: Keep resized state consistent
text: Every resize request shall normalize each dimension to the inclusive range 1..8192 using the shared geometry policy. The viewport, UI root bounds, and published size shall agree.
constraints: No duplicated clamping constants or independent normalization policy.
Preserve the single-threaded synchronous event order.

name: Publish after layout
text: Each resize request shall publish exactly one ViewportChanged event after updating the UI layout.
verification: Nominal, repeated, and event consistency tests
constraints: Exactly one event per request, even if dimensions repeat.

name: Bound cache storage
text: The asset cache shall hold at most four unique resource IDs and evict the oldest insertion on overflow.

name: Isolate future graphics backend
text: Future graphics API calls shall be confined to a platform backend boundary. No backend is implemented in this fixture.
